info.name: Smart Placement API
info.description:
API journey for the Smart Career Placement & Internship Preparation Dashboard.

Uses the httpOnly `sp_token` cookie set by login. Postman keeps cookies automatically. All seeded opportunities are sample data.

Run the folders top to bottom: Health, Auth, Student, Admin, Sign out.

request.description: Creates a fresh student account and starts a session. Uses a timestamped email so repeated runs do not collide.
Sets the sp_token httpOnly cookie. Postman keeps it in its cookie jar.
Sends the complete profile form; omitted optional fields become null.

request.description: Also stores an untracked opportunity ID for the application-tracker requests later.
Stores the first practice task ID for the progress request.

exec: const data = pm.response.json().data; if (data.tasks && data.tasks[0]) pm.collectionVariables.set('practiceTaskId', data.tasks[0].id);
const data = pm.response.json().data; if (data.tasks && data.tasks[0]) pm.collectionVariables.set('roadmapTaskId', data.tasks[0].id);

request.description: Uses the untracked opportunity selected by the list request. Fails with 409 if all opportunities are already tracked.
Select a text-based PDF in the request body before sending. The file is parsed in memory and not stored.
Run after Upload resume PDF. Imports two catalogue skills at proficiency 3.
